pdz.reason: The original supplementary Table 7 has no single-mutant point estimate meeting the >=2-fold gain threshold; changing thresholds would be post hoc.

homer1.uncertainty_method: homer1_ratio_interval_v1; frozen before any new scorer output
homer1.blocking_gap: The 2024 assay's complete biotinylated SUMO-peptide fusion sequence, junction/linker, and fusion orientation are not reported in the article or its five supplements. A related 2022 construct is evidence for a possible lab convention, not proof of the 2024 assay input.
homer1.full_benchmark_reason: At most 9 effect-sized label candidates including all censored rows, only 2 gain candidates, and labels derive from technical repeats of one source.

independence_boundary: Source-paper evaluation of its own predictor is not automatically leakage into this project's scorers. Project exposure, scorer training overlap, structural exposure, and assay-input correspondence are separate. Homer1 is not blind; GraphPep-family/reference exposure is disclosed and checkpoint-wide pretraining overlap remains unresolved.
next_action: Stop this source at the input gate. If later public evidence independently verifies the 2024 fusion sequence and a defensible peptide-versus-fusion modeling representation, freeze the exact input and command configuration before any pilot. Otherwise screen another primary-source system rather than substituting an unverified construct.
